title: Say what an empty table means

do.text: Give the table an `emptyState` that names what is missing and offers the next step.

dont.text: Don't leave the stock message on a table people are meant to fill: it says nothing about what to do.

do.text: Show the few columns a reader compares; put the rest behind a row action, a detail row or the columns menu.

dont.text: Don't show every field: the reader scrolls sideways and loses their row.
